| # Wakeup by CAN {#wakeup-by-can-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                               |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Wakeup by CAN refers to the wakeup of the ECU by receiving a CAN message.

  ![Warning](warning.png){style="margin:0;width:8.3333in;height:0.4583in;border:none"}
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Wherever wakeup by CAN is being used by the application, there should also be a backup mechanism for wakeup i.e., wakeup by T15 is necessary at least as a backup mechanism.

The ECU wakes up by CAN in the following ways:

1.[CAN Wakeup/Wakeup by Pattern (WUP)](wakeup-by-pattern-(wup).html){.topiclink}

2.[Wakeup by Frame (WUF)](wakeup-by-frame-(wuf).html){.topiclink}

 

## CAN channels supported for CAN wakeup: {#can-channels-supported-for-can-wakeup .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  CAN Channel   CAN Wakeup/Wakeup by Pattern (WUP)   Wakeup by Frame (WUF)
  ------------- ------------------------------------ -----------------------
  CAN_1         Yes                                  No
  CAN_2         No                                   No
  CAN_3         No                                   No
  CAN_4         Yes                                  Yes

Wakeup by CAN is enabled only if configured in easyConfig (refer [Parameter Configuration in eC (CAN wakeup)](configuration-parameters-required-for-wakeup-by-can.html){.topiclink}).
